start.title: [TODO:fr] A Father Had Two Sons
start.text:
[TODO:fr] Jesus sits on the hillside.
"A father had two sons. Listen."

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay Awhile
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Some stories find you anyway.
Sit back down.

inheritance.title: [TODO:fr] Give Me My Share
inheritance.text:
[TODO:fr] "Father, give me my inheritance now."
The father divides his wealth.

praise_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Look Closer
praise_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He treats the gift as a wage.
Feel what the father feels.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Love Lets Go
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The father will not force him.
Love gives freedom, even painful.

leaving.title: [TODO:fr] Far From Home
leaving.text:
[TODO:fr] The young son packs his bag.
He walks the road away from home.

cheer_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Yet
cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Freedom without love grows cold.
Watch carefully.

revelry.title: [TODO:fr] Wild Living
revelry.text:
[TODO:fr] In a far country he spent it all
on feasts, friends, and folly.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] It Will Fade
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Pleasure without love is hollow.
Wait and watch.

lookaway_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay With Him
lookaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Mercy does not turn away.
Keep your gaze on him.

famine.title: [TODO:fr] Famine Falls
famine.text:
[TODO:fr] His money is gone. Famine comes.
His friends have all vanished.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Have Mercy
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He is breaking. Do not laugh.
Feel his hunger with him.

pigs.title: [TODO:fr] Among the Pigs
pigs.text:
[TODO:fr] He feeds pigs to survive.
He longs to eat their husks.

pity_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Look Deeper
pity_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] His soul is starting to wake.
Watch what happens inside.

repentance.title: [TODO:fr] I Will Arise
repentance.text:
[TODO:fr] "I will go to my father.
I have sinned. I am not worthy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You do not know that father.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Walk the road home with him

hidden_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Come Home
hidden_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Shame keeps you in the mud.
Repentance rises and walks.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Walk the road home with him

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Trust the Father
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] His love is greater than your fall.
Go, and see.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Walk the road home with him

return.title: [TODO:fr] While He Was Far Off
return.text:
[TODO:fr] The father sees him from afar.
He runs, and falls on his neck.

stern_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Behold the Father
stern_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He does not wait for the speech.
He runs. He kisses. He weeps.

feast.title: [TODO:fr] Bring the Best Robe
feast.text:
[TODO:fr] "My son was lost and is found!
Bring the robe. Begin the feast!"

prove_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Grace, Not Wages
prove_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He was already a son.
Love restores before it asks.

brother.title: [TODO:fr] The Elder Brother
brother.text:
[TODO:fr] The older brother stands in the field.
"He gets a feast? I served you!"

agree_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Wider Than That
agree_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] What feels unfair to pride
is pure joy to love.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Speak Honestly
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The father comes out to you too.
Do not hide your heart.

ending.title: [TODO:fr] We Had to Celebrate
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] "Son, all I have is yours.
But he was lost, and is found."
